bioCard.title: Web Developer, UI/UX & WordPress Developer
paragraphs: Software Engineering graduate with professional experience in web development, UI/UX design, and educational technology. Experienced in developing institutional websites and web-based systems using Laravel, PHP, JavaScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and MySQL.

Also experienced in UI/UX prototyping in Figma, WordPress development, and mentoring students in programming and software projects. Passionate about building user-friendly, scalable, and impactful digital solutions.

timelineItems.title: Laboratory Instructor
